title: Configure a web integration test through the application builder
goal: Supply isolated test configuration and services early enough for real WebApplication startup, while preserving production settings and awaiting fixture disposal.

selectionNotes: The early hook runs during WebApplication.CreateBuilder. It does not override later unconditional application configuration or registrations; the sample uses ??= and TryAddSingleton deliberately.
.NET 10 retains ConfigureWebHost/ConfigureAppConfiguration/ConfigureServices. That valid late path changes request-time values, not values already captured immediately after CreateBuilder.
Current hook rejects explicit IHostBuilder and IWebHostBuilder factory paths. The negative controls deliberately use the historical WebHostBuilder with a local ASPDEPR004 suppression.
ConfigureHostApplicationBuilder was an earlier .NET 11 preview spelling, not a .NET 10 API. No preview package or older-target hook backport is asserted.

Use separate app/test outputs and valid deps/content-root discovery. The test assembly attribute resolves before solution discovery. Await factory DisposeAsync AND an explicit owned-service completion signal when app/factory teardown overlap; preserve production files and persistent environment.
